description: Inspect recent network requests (method, URL, status, type, errors) the browser made. Use to diagnose why a button 'did nothing', find an API endpoint, or confirm a request succeeded.

filter.description: Only requests whose URL contains this substring.

onlyErrors.description: Only failed requests (network error or status >= 400).

type.description: Resource type, e.g. xmlhttprequest, script, document, image.

name: browser_network_log
